verses.text: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of his followers said to him, "Look, Teacher! What huge stones! What wonderful buildings!"
"Do you see all these great buildings?" Jesus replied. "Not one stone here will be left on top of another. Every one of them will be thrown down."
Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, across from the temple. Peter, James, John and Andrew asked him in private,
"Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are all about to come true?"
Jesus began to tell them, "Be careful that no one fools you.
Many will come in my name, saying, 'I am he.' They will fool many people.
When you hear about wars and stories of wars, do not be afraid. These things must happen, but the end has not yet come.
Nation will fight against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in many places, and there will be times of hunger. These are only the beginning of the birth pains.
"Be on your guard. You will be handed over to the local courts and beaten in the synagogues. Because of me, you will stand in front of rulers and kings as witnesses to them.
And the good news must first be preached to all nations.
When you are arrested and brought to trial, do not worry beforehand about what to say. Just say whatever is given to you at that time. It will not be you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
"Brothers will hand each other over to be killed, and fathers will hand over their children. Children will turn against their parents and have them put to death.
Everyone will hate you because of me. But whoever stays strong to the end will be saved.

"You will see 'the terrible thing that destroys' standing where it does not belong, as the prophet Daniel said." Let the reader understand this. "Then those who are in Judea must run away to the mountains.
Anyone on the roof of their house must not go down or go inside to take anything out.
Anyone in the field must not go back to get their coat.
How terrible it will be in those days for women who are pregnant, and for mothers who are feeding their babies!
Pray that this will not happen in winter.
Those days will be a time of terrible suffering. Nothing like it has ever happened from the beginning, when God created the world, until now. And nothing like it will ever happen again.
If the Lord had not made that time shorter, no one would survive. But because of the people he has chosen, he has made it shorter.
At that time, if anyone says to you, 'Look, here is the Christ!' or, 'Look, there he is!' do not believe it.
False Christs and false prophets will appear. They will do signs and wonders to fool even God's chosen people, if that were possible.
So be on your guard. I have told you everything ahead of time.
"But in those days, after that time of suffering, 'the sun will grow dark, and the moon will not give its light.
The stars will fall from the sky, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.'
Then people will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
He will send out his angels. They will gather his chosen people from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the heavens.
"Learn a lesson from the fig tree. When its branches become soft and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.
In the same way, when you see these things happening, you know that the time is near. It is right at the door.
I tell you for certain, the people living now will not pass away until all these things have happened.
Heaven and earth will disappear, but my words will never disappear.
"No one knows the day or the hour when these things will happen. Not even the angels in heaven know, and not even the Son. Only the Father knows.
Be on your guard! Stay awake and pray! You do not know when that time will come.
It is like a man who goes away on a journey. He leaves his house and puts his servants in charge, and he gives each one a job to do. He tells the one at the door to keep watch.
So keep watch! You do not know when the owner of the house will come back. It might be in the evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or at dawn.
If he comes suddenly, do not let him find you sleeping.
What I say to you, I say to everyone: Keep watch!"
